author_direction: Lucas possui uma vulnerabilidade humana real e ainda desconhecida a artes arcanas de intervenção mental (percepção, afeto, memória, coerção de vontade e mal-estar mágico) sem qualquer redução de GÊNESE; a Legião tem superioridade e equipamento histórico; desafio será simultaneamente salvar civis e combater inimigos de elite; Ithran busca Tharvek/Elyrien e enxerga Três Arcos e Lucas como alvos correlatos, sob recursos da estrutura imperial.

canon_anchor.legionsource: ChatGPT-CRÔNICAS DE UM NOVO MUNDO-20261107-2054(1).txt D145/D197 historical records

ratification.rule: Lucas is human in mind and body despite supernatural CREATION/GÊNESE. Magic that operates on mental phenomena may threaten perceptions, emotions, memories, consciousness, and voluntary actions; divine creative power does not automatically establish blanket psychic immunity.
does_not_mean: Lucas is weak, unskilled, cowardly or mentally ill
GÊNESE loses strength, mana, creative functionality or limitations are invented
The enemy may automatically command Lucas to any action without source, casting conditions or a meaningful opportunity to respond
NÓX, SISTEMA, armor or city infrastructure has automatic infallible protection
Every magic spell can defeat him or his allies
ratification.first_reveal: The first genuine effect must be shown and independently assessed; enemy cannot know precise extent before testing and observation.
ratification.old_world: Lucas did not know this exact weakness on Earth because the relevant magical warfare was not part of his experience; do not invent past psychological illness or trauma.
ratification.critical_power_distinction: GÊNESE may manifest material devices and use enormous creative authority; it is not by default mind editing or forced control of emotions. Hostile psychic magic addresses living cognition, not creative capacity.
ratification.lucas_choice_agent: The author retains Lucas's strategic decisions and declared creations. Coercive mental spells may cause short involuntary symptoms or perceptual errors if genuinely landed, but not railroad a major character action or long-term identity change. When compulsion truly matters, narrate signs/conditions and present meaningful countermoves or explicit author choices.

mental_magic_design.proposed_school: Arte dos Véus da Vontade — escola arcana militar PROPOSTA, sem nome canônico ainda. Pode ter linhagens independentes do Dominato; não declarar monopolizada por Velkar.

tiers.effect: Eco sensorial: ouvir uma ordem falsa, enxergar ameaça onde não há, perceber presença ausente.
tiers.dramatic_cost: hesitação, erro de percepção, coordenação comprometida.
tiers.requirements: Concentração e veículo arcano com origem demonstrada; sinais contraditórios podem revelar falsidade.
tiers.counterplay: Testemunhas independentes, reconhecimento por múltiplos sentidos, verificação de origem.

tiers.effect: Pressão emocional: induzir medo, raiva, confiança falsa, culpa ou urgência.
tiers.dramatic_cost: risco de tomar decisão precipitada; reação não é consentimento real.
tiers.requirements: Janela de influência, alvo afetado e contexto significativo; não funciona sobre cidade toda por onda arbitrária.
tiers.counterplay: Aliados que conhecem o comportamento, pausa, linguagem de verificação, distância ou interrupção do ritual.

tiers.effect: Falso fragmento de memória, lembrança obscurecida ou reconstrução enviesada.
tiers.dramatic_cost: desconfiança de si e dos demais, conflito com fatos.
tiers.requirements: Magia especializada e trabalho coerente de focalização; não fabrica passado canônico nem muda arquivos materiais.
tiers.counterplay: Registros autenticados, comparação de testemunhas, análise arcana de Miren/Astra.

tiers.effect: Compulsão momentânea ou sugestão irresistível SOB CONDIÇÕES demonstradas, sem assumir posse permanente.
tiers.dramatic_cost: pequeno ato involuntário possível, com repercussão emocional séria.
tiers.requirements: Condições de lançamento e sustentação narradas, acesso plausível, falha possível e sinais aos interlocutores.
tiers.counterplay: Quebra de concentração, auxílio, interferência externa, treinamento, barreiras ou reação de Lucas segundo escolha real.

tiers.effect: Mal-estar arcano e interferência de foco: calor, vertigem, fadiga ou confusão temporária.
tiers.dramatic_cost: Lucas se sente humano e vulnerável em momento de urgência; GÊNESE não é drenada.
tiers.requirements: Incidente mágico com origem e intensidade proporcionais; não diagnosticar doença real.
tiers.counterplay: Exame médico/arcano, isolamento da origem, descanso/ajuda, proteção progressiva a pesquisar.

spell_limits: Não executar telepatia global nem controle de toda a cidade
Alcance, duração, preparo, número de alvos, sinais e custo mágico definidos no contexto da cena
A resistência de cada alvo pode variar; resultados variáveis após contato comprovado
Falsa memória não retcona fato canônico; é percepção falsa identificável
Efeitos não atravessam automaticamente salvaguardas, armaduras ou distância conhecida
Não fazer o jogador escolher sob falsa premissa sem que o próprio texto permita identificar possibilidade de engano
Se Lucas conseguir interromper um feitiço com GÊNESE ou ajuda real, a vitória permanece válida

defense_development_ideas.proposition: Miren/Astra verificam interferência mental por métodos científicos e arcanos, separando magia real de exaustão comum.
Varo/Legião treinam testemunhos cruzados, autonomia das equipes e reconhecimento de ordens estranhas sem supor que podem ler pensamentos.
Forja/SAEL/Brannik estudam capacetes Aurora, sinais sensoriais e registro de ordens como mitigação; eficácia deve ser testada e não exige limitação de GÊNESE.
NÓX, Rumo, Miren e Varo percebem comportamento inesperado por convivência; não lhes atribuir detector mágico automático.
Lucas aprende a identificar e resistir a influências mentais específicas por experiência, magia, ajuda, engenharia e escolhas; não virar invulnerabilidade universal instantânea.

legion_historical_inventory.baseline_300: Primeira Legião: 300 indivíduos originais livres, treinados, infantaria pesada de elite; sem ratio matemático fixo de combates no cânone.

day145.varo_armor: Égide da Aurora, armadura de comando e proteção modular, uso supervisionado autorizado

legion_historical_inventory.caution: Do not claim numbers remained unchanged by D545/D548 or all 300 have the newer equipment; later status must be obtained from canon.

not_guaranteed_against: Different terrain and civilians in jeopardy
Magic, logistics, line of sight and exhaustion
benchmark.illustrative_only: 30 standard opponents exceed a one-legionnaire 1:20 benchmark; 30 elite specialist opponents represent completely different variable pressure. 300 legionnaires do not translate mathematically to a guaranteed 6000 enemy defeat.

legion_historical_inventory.none_left_behind: Ethos = make every reasonable effort to protect/recover companions and civilians, no impossible guarantee or rule to doom entire unit.

ithran_grand_strategy.strategic_commander: Velkar (political commander, distant and with delayed information)
ithran_grand_strategy.sponsorship: Imperial budget, specialist personnel, forged legal pretenses and arcane research are possible funded resources of Serakh/Velkar, but precise funds, troops and access require demonstration; no automatic ownership of all nine crowns.
ithran_grand_strategy.doctrine: Ithran uses plausible intelligence, magic, travel, pressure and psychology; military victory by 30 troops against the entire high-tech city is not prewritten.

three_objectives.name: THARVEK_AND_ELYRIEN
three_objectives.goal: Locate, intercept or coerce the two people perceived as strategically capable of joining independent peoples; they retain agency and their paths must reach the city physically.

three_objectives.name: THREE_ARCHES
three_objectives.goal: Undermine the city's belief in safety and its ability to coordinate civic defense, while seeking privileged knowledge/technology from Forja/AERÚN where feasible.

three_objectives.name: LUCAS
three_objectives.goal: Test whether CREATION's immense capability coexists with an untrained vulnerability to mind magic, without knowing the truth before observations.

ithran_grand_strategy.strategic_caveat: Três Arcos might be easier than Thalor to approach covertly due to smaller scale and public openness, but is NOT necessarily easier to occupy or defeat; elite Legion, functioning towers, magic, autonomous Sombras and GÊNESE can make conquest incredibly hard.
intelligence_path: Serakh/Ithran learn of emissary journeys through sources and realistic delays
Ithran acquires maps or reports about infrastructure and civic psychology via legal/illegal observations with detectability
Enemy may learn Lucas lacks PREVIOUS psychic combat training; cannot infer automatic susceptibility
Probe/contact with a mind-focused caster occurs under witnessed circumstances; multiple possible failures
Only after verified evidence can Ithran adapt to exploit this avenue; information to Velkar travels normally
ithran_grand_strategy.relation_to_vesra: Vesra Keth is a separate known enemy; no automatic patronage by Ithran, Serakh or Velkar nor retroactive attribution of prior attacks.
ithran_grand_strategy.previous_first_wound_rule: A citywide wound may occur earlier through other enemies. Ithran's later assault can be a major escalation or distinct second blow; no need to wait for envoys to make C03 action happen.
ithran_grand_strategy.avoid_invasion_claim: No future casualties, control of Lucas, victory or embassy meeting is canon by planning.

scenario_matrix.title: TRINTA CONTRA UM
scenario_matrix.setup: A single elite legionnaire faces thirty enemies in a fantasy battle, some ordinary, some experienced in disruptive arcana; the historic 1:20 heuristic is stressed.
scenario_matrix.choice: Defend chokepoint, seek reinforcements, protect bystanders or execute independent withdrawal; not a guaranteed heroic death.
scenario_matrix.enemy_possible: Win tactical delay, lose members, withdraw, be captured.
scenario_matrix.payoff: An elite soldier can be extraordinary and still not be everywhere.

scenario_matrix.title: DEZ INIMIGOS OU DEZ VIDAS
scenario_matrix.setup: Ten attackers are escaping while ten civilians are in immediate peril. A legionary must prioritize under seconds of pressure.
scenario_matrix.choice: Protection, pursuit, split squad, adaptive equipment or invention may save both if earned.
scenario_matrix.enemy_possible: Escape or capture depending on actions.
scenario_matrix.payoff: Nenhum fica para trás becomes a hard choice, not a slogan; no fixed loss.

scenario_matrix.title: O COMANDO QUE NINGUÉM DEU
scenario_matrix.setup: An operator receives a convincing false command through mind magic while authentic communications and manual overrides still exist.
scenario_matrix.choice: Validate orders, compare testimony, stop local equipment, defend family or fight spellcaster.
scenario_matrix.enemy_possible: Temporary local confusion, not automatic takeover of towers or 3.600 automatons.
scenario_matrix.payoff: Três Arcos learns to defend its chain of trust as well as its walls.

scenario_matrix.title: O CRIADOR VÊ O QUE NÃO EXISTE
scenario_matrix.setup: A hostile spell makes Lucas briefly see Miren, Varo or innocent people in the wrong place while combat rages.
scenario_matrix.choice: Test perceptions, use allies, choose creations, or counterattack; author always controls strategic choices.
scenario_matrix.enemy_possible: Momentary distress or misdirected reaction only if effect actually lands.
scenario_matrix.payoff: True first contact with mental vulnerability; GÊNESE still intact.

scenario_matrix.title: A NOITE DOS SETORES
scenario_matrix.setup: Simultaneous but causally linked incidents affect city travel, public reception, a guarded research area and the duty of rescue, with 2–4 sectors in scene.
scenario_matrix.choice: Varo/Legion, Sombras, Miren/Astra, Kael/Lysa and volunteers act independently; Lucas can respond creatively.
scenario_matrix.enemy_possible: Interception, partial damage, defeat or retreat.
scenario_matrix.payoff: A city can lose the sense of invulnerability even if the battle is won, provided a real crisis occurred.

scenario_matrix.title: AS TRÊS PRESAS DE ITHRAN
scenario_matrix.setup: Tharvek and Elyrien approach Três Arcos through real routes. Ithran has acquired partial intel and positions his high-risk diplomatic/magical offensive.
scenario_matrix.choice: Emissaries can refuse/travel/alter route; Ithran can fail; defenders can discover operation early.
scenario_matrix.enemy_possible: Target capture, political split, loss of surprise, arrest or death; all open.
scenario_matrix.payoff: The three separate objectives meet, but the city is never helpless.

scenario_matrix.title: O FEITIÇO QUE FAZ A CRIAÇÃO HESITAR
scenario_matrix.setup: Ithran or a trained adversary applies a cognition-affecting spell at a moment of choice, creating genuine urgency without reducing raw power.
scenario_matrix.choice: Lucas may rely on Varo, NÓX, Miren, reason, physical intervention, alternate techniques or GÊNESE; success earned by action.
scenario_matrix.enemy_possible: Influence broken or temporarily effective; no forced irreversible player action.
scenario_matrix.payoff: The first meaningful learning step toward mental defense, rather than permanent weakness.

scenario_matrix.title: A RESPOSTA DE VARO
scenario_matrix.setup: After a real battle, Varo faces injured colleagues and civilians demanding action; Legion's elite victory alone did not protect everyone.
scenario_matrix.choice: Tactical training, specialized civilian rescue, protocols, volunteers and independent justice; social discussion without tyranny.
scenario_matrix.enemy_possible: No villains' guaranteed victory by rhetoric.
scenario_matrix.payoff: A wounded Legion and united city change doctrine and identity together.

safety_and_agency: No magic rewrites canon facts; mental influence is subjective in-world and can be investigated.
Do not narrate forceful mind-control decision by Lucas without user interaction and viable reactions.
No mental illness stigma or real-life diagnosis; magical symptoms are fictional.
No groupmind spell that flips 300 conscious legionnaires as disposable puppets.
Mind war is genuinely threatening but every cast can fail under plausible resistance and counteraction.
Do not create human life with GÊNESE in this stage.
No forced casualty quota, no forced battle loss, no fabricated invasion if prevented.
Do not disclose technical real-world methods of undermining civilian infrastructure; fantasy storytelling centers on effects, magic and defense.
Caedren historical flag and C02PV chronological blocker remain separate.
